Hi Anna —

Appreciate the clear list. Karthik and I reviewed the RFI and sketched a compact proforma that should fit a pilot while leaving room for scale. High-level notes below; attached is a short spreadsheet (redwood-proforma-retainer-2026Q2.xlsx) with the math.

Uptime tiers and suggested crediting (pilot-friendly):
- 99.5% (Standard): no credits for brief interruptions under 15 minutes; any single incident > 60 minutes => 5% monthly credit.
- 99.9% (Assured): single incident > 30 minutes => 10% monthly credit; cumulative below target => prorated credit across affected routes.
- 99.95% (Priority): single incident > 15 minutes => 15% monthly credit + optional 4-hour on-call callback SLA (paid retainer).

Response windows & escalation coverage (example):
- Triage acknowledgement: 15 minutes (automated + human assignment)
- Initial triage update: 60 minutes for Priority, 3 hours for Assured, 6 hours for Standard
- On-call engineering callback: within 4 hours when Priority retainer is purchased; otherwise best-effort during US business hours

Regional notes: limiting premium on-call to US production reduces retainer by ~40% compared to global coverage; we reflect that in the proforma as an entitlement filter (Region: US-only).

Retainer split (pilot example):
- Monthly retainer: covers 24/7 monitoring, 1 named on-call rotation (US-only), up to 8 on-call callbacks per month.
- Overage hourly: $250/hr for engineering callback beyond included callbacks; $150/hr for post-incident RCA and follow-up work billed separately (not included in retainer).
- Trial concession: first-month retainer reduced by 50% if pilot goes live within 30 days.

We can tighten the wording on credit triggers and include explicit SLA definitions in the SOW. Karthik — are you able to join a call on Wednesday (4/29) at 11am PT? Laura, looped for approval on the trial concession.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Hi Anna — thanks, Olga. Quick clarifications from pricing so procurement can slot line items into their SOW: 

1) Credit cap: credits are capped at 30% of monthly invoice for any given billing period (we've put that in the proforma).
2) Measurement window: uptime measured over customer-routed production traffic only; scheduled maintenance windows > 2 hours are excluded with a 7-day notice.
3) Escalation roster: included retainer provides named on-call list (3 engineers) plus a single escalation manager during business hours; after-hours escalation manager incurs a small lift fee unless Priority retainer is purchased.

Pricing highlights (pilot-sized commit):
- Monthly retainer (US-only, Priority entitlements): $9,000/mo (includes up to 8 callbacks).
- Overage callback rate: $250/hour (billed in 15-minute increments).
- RCA/engineering follow-up hours: $150/hour after the first 4 hours included for Priority incidents.

Discounts & concessions we can offer now: 15% off the first 3 months for pilots with an executed SOW; 5% volume credit if you commit to a three-zone expansion within 12 months.

If that looks broadly acceptable, I'll prepare a clean SOW excerpt and an updated proforma with line items for procurement.

—Karthik
Senior Solutions, Redwood Inference
